items.subject: adam
items.retained_pixel_rule: colored pixels only; all grayscale text/background removed
items.scan_window_detection: columns with colored-pixel coverage above 35%; grayscale gaps up to 4 px closed; longest wide interval selected; 8 px display margin added
items.interpretation: Recorded scan ECG/gating raster from GE Secondary Capture; no voltage calibration and no DICOM WaveformSequence.
items.scan_window_interpretation: Pixel-exact crop of the interval highlighted by the GE report; no resampling, interpolation, or waveform reconstruction.
